title: Lutispora thermophila strain:m25 Genome sequencing and assembly
description: Landfills are heterogenic understudied environments, and much is still obscure regarding the microbial communities occupying landfills and their related diversity and function. Here we report on the whole genome sequencing of a novel representative species of Lutispora genus, strain m25, isolated from a landfill lab-scale methanogenic bioreactors.
samples: MIGS Cultured Bacterial/Archaeal sample from Lutispora saccharofermentans
